name: pr-comment-evaluator
tagline_zh: PR 评论太冲？同事看了想拉黑？用这个 skill 测出每条评论的「礼貌分」，还能指出哪句最伤人。
tagline_en: Is your PR comment too harsh? This skill scores politeness, flags the sharpest line, and turns snark into smooth.
desc_en: Use to judge whether a PR review comment sounds polite.
why_zh: 它不只看关键词，而是分析语气转折和上下文，连反讽都能识别，比简单词库准一个量级。
why_en: Goes beyond keywords—detects sarcasm and tone shifts in context, outperforming simple word lists by a clear margin.
